Sources.Name: Compendium Sources
Sources.Label: Configure
Sources.Hint: Which compendiums summons and their items come from, in priority order.

SummonAnimation.Name: Summon animation
SummonAnimation.Hint: Sequencer database key or file path played where a summon appears. Blank for none.

DismissAnimation.Name: Dismiss animation
DismissAnimation.Hint: Sequencer database key or file path played where a summon leaves. Blank for none.

DismissAtZeroHp.Name: Dismiss at 0 HP
DismissAtZeroHp.Hint: Remove a summon when its hit points drop to 0 or lower.

AddToCombat.Name: Add summons to combat
AddToCombat.Hint: Add summons to the active combat right after their summoner.

GroupWithSummoner.Name: Group summons with their summoner
GroupWithSummoner.Hint: With Astora's grouped initiative, summons join their summoner's group and act on its turn.

Lists.Name: Summon Lists
Lists.Label: Edit
Lists.Hint: Add to or change the shipped summon lists, families and templates.

Lists.Title: Summon Lists
Lists.Hint: Your changes on top of the shipped data, by id: the same id replaces, a new id adds, "disabled": true removes.

ResetConfirm.Title: Clear Summon List Changes
ResetConfirm.Body: Empty the editor? Nothing is saved until you press Save.

Error.NotObject: The changes must be a JSON object.
Error.Options: {where}: "options" must be entries with an "id" and an "item".
Error.Tier: {where}, level {level}: must be entries with a "name".

Sources.Title: Compendium Sources
Sources.ActorsHint: Searched top to bottom for summoned creatures by name.
Sources.ItemsHint: Searched top to bottom for templates and items added to summons.
Sources.CacheHint: Compendium actors are imported here on first use.

ClearConfirm.Title: Clear Summon Cache
ClearConfirm.Body: Delete {count} cached actors? They are imported again on next use.

Sources.InUse: {skipped} still used by tokens on a scene are kept.

Relay.NoGM: A GM must be connected to summon.
Relay.Timeout: The GM did not respond in time.

Sheet.Title: Summoning
Sheet.ListsHint: None ticked uses every list of this type.
Sheet.ClearActor: Unlink actor; look up by name instead
Sheet.EntriesHint: Drop an actor here, or type a name to look up in the compendium sources.
Sheet.ItemsHint: Added to every summon. Drop an item or type a name.
Sheet.DataHint: Read on the summon as @summonInfo.name; cl, sl and saveDC are always set.
Sheet.AnimationHint: Sequencer key or file path. Blank uses the default; none for no animation.

Augment.Title: Summon Augment
Augment.ScopeItemsHint: Drop or name the summoning spells and abilities this applies to.
Augment.ItemsHint: Put on every summon this applies to. Drop an item or type a name.
Augment.ItemsOnly: Only on summons from added lists
Augment.ListsHint: Their creatures join the picker, marked *.
Augment.ListsNone: No extra lists. Mark one "extra": true in Summon Lists.
Augment.OnlyIfMultiple: Only when summoning more than one
Augment.DurationHint: Multipliers from several sources combine like critical multipliers: two ×2 make ×3.

Summary.ItemsAdded: Adds {items} to summons from added lists.
Summary.QuantityMultiple: +{bonus} creatures when summoning more than one.

Place.Label: {name}: {n} of {total}
Place.Invalid: Out of range or line of sight.
Place.NoSummoner: The summoner isn't on this scene, so range isn't limited.

Buff.Name: Summoned: {item}
Buff.Description: Created by a summoning. The summon is dismissed when this ends or is removed.

Warn.NoScene: There is no active scene to summon into.
Warn.NoneRolled: The quantity rolled was 0; nothing to place.
Warn.ActorNotFound: No actor named "{name}" in the compendium sources.
Warn.ActorMissing: The actor for {name} no longer exists.
Warn.ItemMissing: Item "{name}" not found in the compendium sources; skipped.
Warn.NoFamily: This summon has no summon type set.
Warn.NoLists: No summon lists exist for this summon type.
Warn.BadLevel: Summon level {level} has no list to draw from.
